ui.knowledge-local.how-the-assistant-con: How the assistant confirms before calling each tool; destructive actions always ask you.

ui.knowledge-local.images-are-sent-with-: Images are sent with this message · originals aren't saved in chat history

ui.knowledge-local.local-hub-calendar-cl: Local hub (calendar / clipboard; small local models as helpers)

ui.knowledge-local.no-events-in-the-next: No events in the next two weeks

ui.knowledge-local.once-authorized-nomi-: Once authorized, Nomi can only read and write inside these folders.
ui.knowledge-local.only-use-local-models: Only use local models and never send requests to cloud models.

ui.knowledge-local.please-review-the-lic: Please review the license before downloading
ui.knowledge-local.please-take-a-look-at: Please take a look at this image.

ui.knowledge-local.recall-relevant-past-: Recall relevant past conversations when answering

ui.knowledge-local.start-time-leave-empt: Start time (leave empty for all day)
